songs.title: What Will You Do Tomorrow? 🗓️
lines: What will you do? What will you do?
Tomorrow? Tomorrow?
I will watch a movie, I will watch a movie,
Very soon! Very soon!
What will she eat? What will she eat?
Next Sunday? Next Sunday?
She will eat some pizza, she will eat some pizza
Yum, yum, yum! Yum, yum, yum!
n: 곡조: Frère Jacques (Are You Sleeping?) (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'What will you do?'에서 손바닥을 위로 펴 묻고, 'movie'는 두 손으로 화면 모양, 'pizza'는 한 입 먹는 흉내를 카메라 앞에서 해요.
songs.imgPrompt: Cheerful children sitting on a sofa planning tomorrow, one watching a movie on TV and a girl happily eating pizza.

songs.title: Where Are You Going to Go? 🚇
lines: Where are you going to go?
I am sick! I am sick!
Going to the pharmacy,
For medicine!
Where are you going to go?
I'm hungry! I'm hungry!
Going to the restaurant,
I'm starving now!
n: 곡조: London Bridge Is Falling Down (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'sick'에서 이마에 손을 얹고, 'hungry'에서 배를 문지르며, 'going to'에서 제자리 걷기를 해요.
songs.imgPrompt: A cartoon town street where a sick boy walks to a pharmacy and a hungry girl runs toward a restaurant.

songs.title: I Am Going to Be Rich 💎
lines: I am going to be rich!
What will I buy? My, oh my!
I will buy some jewelry,
Treasure for my family!
Where will we go? When and why?
On a journey, way up high!
I am going to be rich!
What will I buy? My, oh my!
n: 곡조: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'rich'에서 두 팔을 활짝 벌리고, 'What will I buy?'에서 손가락으로 화면 여기저기를 가리키며, 'way up high'에서 비행기 팔을 해요.
songs.imgPrompt: Happy children with a sparkling treasure chest full of jewelry, flying off on a journey in a small airplane.
